results.title: Vaccine-grade storage verified by periodic thermal imaging, not continuous monitoring
results.closest_fact_claim: Gubba's facilities are among the finest vaccine facilities in India, with a capacity of 3 crore vaccine doses, and developed dedicated COVID-19 vaccine storage with roughly 6,300 pallets split into chambers of 1,200 pallets each across 15-25°C, 2-8°C, and -20°C zones under one roof.

results.title: Lean 83-person team spanning 17 facilities across two cities
results.closest_fact_claim: Gubba Cold Storage was Andhra Pradesh's first cold storage, started in 1987 by Gubba Nagender Rao, and has grown to 1.25 crore cubic feet of capacity across 17 cold storages in Hyderabad and Aurangabad.

results.title: Multiple precision temperature/humidity zones under one roof need granular audit trails
results.closest_fact_claim: Gubba's facilities provide climate-controlled preservation across a temperature range of +20°C to -22°C, with relative humidity maintained between 40% and 90%.
